note: One accent per character, taken from the character's established look. Film looks come first (the most recent released appearance, or the version Marvel named for Doomsday); comics are used where the film look would clash or is not described. Each source is a Marvel Cinematic Universe Wiki or Marvel Fandom wiki page read through the wiki's MediaWiki API (action=parse) and cited by its normal /wiki/ URL. No source gives hex codes: every hex is our own judgement, matched by eye to the colour the page describes (or, where flagged, to a colour the page only shows). Contrast is the WCAG 2 ratio against the background #0d1012, from the relative luminance formula with sRGB linearisation; every accent clears 4.5:1, and dark costume colours were lightened just enough to clear it. Distinctness is CIE76 Delta E in CIELAB (D65 white), with a target of at least 12 between any two characters; the closest pair is sam-wilson and ghost at 13.2. Where several heroes share a costume colour (Captain America blue, the X-Men blues, the reds), one keeps it and the others take their second most characteristic element; hexNote says which and why. Doom's cloak green is fixed and doubles as the site's base glow. 'current' is DESIGN[slug].accent in src/data/site.ts on 26 October 2026, for comparison. Nothing here is applied to the site yet.

characters.name: VICTOR VON DOOM
characters.title: Doom's green cloak and robes over his iron armour (Fantastic Four Vol 1 5, 1962, onward)
characters.fromWhat: the green cloak and robes worn over the armour

source.label: Marvel Fandom wiki, Doctor Doom's Armor

characters.hexNote: matched by eye to the described costume colour (the page mentions his green cloak and robes). This is also the site's base glow: cloak green that deepens toward iron on the gunmetal ground. Fixed by the brief.
characters.roleNote: Marvel names the role (Victor von Doom).

characters.fromWhat: the navy blue of his Captain America uniform
characters.hexNote: matched by eye to the described costume colour (the page calls his stealth suit navy and his later suits red, white and blue). Lightened for legibility: true navy is far below 4.5:1 on this ground. Kept muted so it reads apart from Mystique's saturated cobalt.
characters.roleNote: Marvel names the role (Steve Rogers).

characters.name: SAM WILSON

characters.fromWhat: the white that replaced blue as the main colour of his Captain America suit
characters.hexNote: matched by eye to the described costume colour (the page says white became the primary suit colour). Chosen over blue so Sam and Steve read as two different Captains. Runner-up: the purple glow his vibranium wings give off as they store energy (same page), set aside because Shuri already holds that glow.
characters.roleNote: Marvel lists Anthony Mackie in the cast without naming the role; this uses the most recent released look (Sam Wilson / Captain America).

characters.roleNote: Marvel lists Sebastian Stan in the cast without naming the role; this uses the most recent released look (Bucky Barnes).
